My plot is small, only 0.19 hectares, but maize is what feeds my family so I must give it what I can. I will buy a bag or two of fertilizer if the AIP coupon comes through — without it the yield is too poor. I keep a few chickens and goats so I spread what manure I gather, and I intercrop with pigeon peas to help the soil. I cannot afford irrigation or much hired help, so me and my household will do most of the work by hand.
